scope: Generated C compilation and native DLL linking only. Excludes Tide generation, assets, engine/package compilation and packaging.
protocol: Single exploratory pass per mode, at most five concurrent compilers; ordinary desktop load, no quiet-machine gate. Separate successful native DLL links retain tide_game_api as an exported root, use the checkout-built engine/platform/Box3D libraries, bridge, and game saves/perf C. No unresolved symbols allowed. Earlier failed incomplete link probes are excluded.

limitations: Exploratory measurements, not a statistical performance guarantee.
Four-part prototype used the initial partitioner; the final code adds stable API placement, cache integration, shader constant warning fixes and current dev integration.
Private game sources, generated C and asset packs are not committed.
The data-only partition experiment did not improve C compilation.
target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc (CLI packages normally target MinGW on Windows)
